remarks: Well-maintained 4-bedroom, 2 full-bath home situated on a fully fenced, half-acre-plus lot with two outbuildings. The expanded kitchen/rec room overlooks the deck, patio, and spacious backyard, providing plenty of room for everyday living and entertaining. Additional features include a 220 sq. ft. enclosed porch, 18' x 10' heated breezeway connecting the home and garage, and a 2.5-car garage (576 sq. ft.).Hardwood floors throughout, and the living room features a wood-burning fireplace. The finished basement provides additional living and recreational space. A whole-house generator was installed in 2016. All kitchen appliances are included in “as-is” condition. A well-maintained property with generous indoor and outdoor space and plenty of storage.Showings start Monday 10/19/2026, negotiations start Friday 10/23/2026
